subject: general
question: To combat eve teasing, sexual harassment and other crimes against women, 91 Nirbhaya Squads comprising of specially trained police officers were launched in ________ on 26 January 2022.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mumbai.**__

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__****

__
 
• Eve teasing can be understood to mean **sexual harassment of women in public places** such as streets, public transportation, workplace etc. 
 
• Eve teasing is one of the forms of **gendered crimes against women**. It is one of the methods of enjoyment of men who sees women as mere objects.
 
• Eve is believed to be the first woman that God made on earth. All women are therefore generically termed as eve. The literal meaning of teasing is **to make** **fun of a person, playfully, unkindly or annoyingly**.
 
• The **section 294 IPC (vi)** penalizes certain acts of obscenity in public places i.e., whoever sings, recites, utters any obscene song, ballad, words to the annoyance of others is made punishable.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The article **'Eve Teasing: The Social Evil'** attempts to explain the present scenario of eve-teasing and the legislative provisions associated with the same. It also discusses how any victim of such a crime can successfully file a complaint. 
 
• Eve teasing is considered a **civil wrong in society**. The perpetrator hurts the victim both physically and psychologically. Her dignity and the right of women to privacy are being violated.
 
• According to **Section 292 of the Indian Penal Code**, 1860, a man who displays any pornographic or obscene images, books, or papers to a woman or a girl faces a fine of Rs. 2000 and a 2-year prison sentence.
 
• According to **Section 354**, if force is used to **affront a woman's modesty**, the offender will be penalized under this section provided that there was a conscious effort on his part to do so.
